turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are, Hale. Why did Owen learn about this zero from his phone?
Okay. Let's look at the essay.
You skipped my question. Answer it first.
You're very sharp, you know that?
Save it. Was Owen heard before you entered that mark, yes or no?
No, really. You caught the timestamp issue in thirty seconds. That's sharp.
I haven't seen any timestamp. Show me what you actually have.
I just keep thinking, someone that sharp must see why I had to flag it.
Had to, on what? Put it on the desk or stop flattering me.
